reason: Acquiring a majority stake in Armed Cell Therapeutics allows the company to enter the high-growth CAR-T therapy market, diversifying its revenue stream beyond traditional pharmaceuticals.
why_now: The acquisition was announced via press release on October 15, 2026.
source_headlines: Mankind Pharma Limited: Mankind Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 15, 2026, titled "Press Release titled Mankind Pharma to Acquire Majority Stake in Armed Cell Therapeutics, Marking Strategic Entry into Next-Generation CAR-T Therapies ".
